findings.feature: Course/layout editors, custom lessons, full preferences and shortcut configuration
findings.verdict: Explicit MVP cuts, not established OS prohibitions.
findings.observed: KTOUCH_HARMONY_MVP guards return before the KDE-backed flows; port notes explicitly choose small shims over a complete KDE port.
findings.next_step: Restore one flow with real dependencies or a scoped replacement; validate persistence and dialogs. Keyboard-system KCM must be evaluated separately.

findings.verdict: Selected build excludes bindings; fundamental impossibility is unproven.
findings.observed: Port notes and the patch identify a -nopython -noruby -without-qtbinding build. This review did not reconstruct every release invocation.
findings.next_step: Establish the exact release flags, then port/package the interpreter, extension ABI and resource closure. Embedded Python in another app is a counterexample to a blanket language ban, not proof of KLayout binding parity.

findings.verdict: Unadapted integration; HarmonyOS PC printing exists.
findings.observed: README lists printing as unavailable without a causal diagnosis; the repository does not include the full native application implementation in the reviewed CMake entry.
findings.next_step: Trace Qt PrintSupport/QPA support or export PDF and integrate a native print handoff; test printer discovery, cancellation and actual output.

findings.verdict: Missing in this port; exact blocking dependency not established.
findings.observed: README lists unadapted functionality and explicitly reports insufficient maintenance resources. It does not provide a per-feature root cause.
findings.next_step: Acquire the actual native source/build inputs and inspect plotting/interpreter dependencies. FreeCAD is only a counterexample to an OS-wide 3D/Python ban.

findings.verdict: Historical defensive disablement; restoration patches exist.
findings.observed: The debugging guide identifies FREECAD_OHOS guards around drawing calls, then restores calls and fixes the Qt/gl4es texture namespace boundary.
findings.next_step: Validate rendering, cube picking and rotation separately. The guide itself leaves the mixed FBO picking path unverified.

findings.verdict: Port/dependency and window-parent bugs were repaired in source.
findings.observed: README identifies disabled QUiLoader plus missing PySide QtUiTools; a native UiTools patch exists. The debugging guide separately repairs popup parenting.
findings.next_step: Exercise form loading, popup/tooltip interaction and saved preferences on device; the author reports success, which was not rerun here.

findings.feature: Interactive PTY terminal and job control
findings.verdict: App-domain restriction reported on a specific device/runtime; not independently reproduced.
findings.observed: The specification reports SELinux denials for forkpty/openpty and missing application PTY APIs. It separately reports working non-PTY fork/exec/pipes and implements a resident shell.
findings.next_step: Reproduce PTY denial on the exact device/API/signing profile before calling it a confirmed restriction. Non-PTY command execution does not restore TTY semantics.

findings.verdict: Missing libvips was partly replaced; image processing was not simply removed.
findings.observed: README and JS bridge code route conversions to the ArkTS image framework, permit bounded clean-file pass-through and reject unavailable conversions. Thumbnails remain absent.
findings.next_step: Test conversion, EXIF orientation, limits and no-bridge errors; investigate thumbnail work separately. Do not equate a sharp stub with complete feature loss.

findings.verdict: Signing/distribution restriction asserted by the author; eligibility claim is not independently verified.
findings.observed: README attributes missing standalone runtimes to binary-certificate eligibility. It distinguishes optional system-installed pnpm from bundled product capability.
findings.next_step: Verify current HNP/ELF signing and account eligibility using official policy for this exact product. Embedded CPython libraries in FreeCAD are not the same packaging route.

findings.verdict: Explicit engineering tradeoff.
findings.observed: README says the frameless design was deferred because moving controls into the renderer costs more than it buys.
findings.next_step: Treat as product scope unless a concrete window-mode requirement justifies implementing and validating it.

findings.verdict: Already implemented at the reviewed revision.
findings.observed: The OH startup branch constructs Tray, sets its tooltip and installs a context menu. DSH also contains a StatusBarManager adapter.
findings.next_step: Validate icon, menu, hide/show and lifecycle on the relevant PC runtime. Do not infer full tray API parity from construction alone.

findings.verdict: Desktop update path is gated; a distribution integration question.
findings.observed: setupAutoUpdater explicitly returns when IS_OHOS is true; its comment defers the update channel to the application store.
findings.next_step: Select an approved signed-HAP distribution/update mechanism for the product; absence of electron-updater support does not mean applications cannot be updated.

findings.feature: Terminal, debugger, LSP and extension installation in default mode
findings.verdict: Default server-mode reductions, not demonstrated OS impossibility.
findings.observed: staticLabServer disables terminal/debugger/LSP/completer extensions, returns terminal-unavailable responses and marks extension installation read-only. The README also offers Python/external-server modes.
findings.next_step: Build a per-mode matrix. An external server can supply server-side services subject to client support; a local PTY still requires its own policy/implementation assessment.

findings.verdict: Runtime stability workaround.
findings.observed: README defaults OH Electron GPU composition off because of instability; frontend editing and Pyodide remain available.
findings.next_step: Reproduce on the pinned Electron/engine/GPU set before changing the default. This does not establish a lack of GPU capability in HarmonyOS.

findings.feature: Single-instance events and newer Electron APIs
findings.verdict: Electron-port/version coverage gap; lifecycle integration is incomplete.
findings.observed: Feasibility notes distinguish an available Electron port from compatibility with all newer APIs. FEATURE_MATRIX still labels lifecycle/file routing as pending.
findings.next_step: Route duplicate launch and file intents through Ability/Want; verify cold/warm paths. The feasibility note is a lead, not independent testing of every Electron API.

findings.verdict: RNOH adapter incompleteness, not a proven ArkWeb/OS prohibition.
findings.observed: Vendored adapter documentation has a property support matrix and issues for props not yet adapted to HarmonyOS.
findings.next_step: Choose a specific prop, inspect its native implementation and ArkWeb equivalent, then test that prop. Some iOS-only semantics may require redesign.

findings.verdict: Missing FFmpeg backend artifact; source names replacement work.
findings.observed: README describes a vendored empty FFmpeg hook and says an OH FFmpeg build or system capability is needed.
findings.next_step: Implement a compatible recorder or native backend; validate codecs, stream protocols, output finalization and background lifecycle.

findings.verdict: Missing/unselected plugin integrations.
findings.observed: README identifies mobile_scanner as a local Kotlin plugin and points to a CPF WebView adaptation as future work.
findings.next_step: Audit plugin-native coverage and select a compatible backend. No claim is made here that the named replacement is currently available or PC-validated.

findings.verdict: The selected libmpv build lacks the OH hardware-decoder backend.
findings.observed: README explicitly distinguishes CPU decode/GPU rendering and proposes an AVPlayer/video_player_ohos path absent from the upstream media_core backend.
findings.next_step: Check protocol, headers, HDR, subtitles and texture integration before selecting a hardware-backed player; GPU rendering is not evidence of hardware decode.

findings.verdict: Plugin/host integration work; the README already identifies a native PiP path.
findings.observed: Later README text names PiPWindow and missing Flutter texture bridging; an earlier blanket no-corresponding-PC-tray statement conflicts with native PC APIs and other reviewed adapters.
findings.next_step: Prototype PiP surface handoff separately from in-app mini-player; use a PC status-bar adapter and retain API/product gates.

findings.verdict: Explicit app UI gate plus a dependency-support explanation.
findings.observed: The TTS settings callback only shows an OH-unsupported message. README attributes this and highlighting loss to Flutter dependency support.
findings.next_step: Map the TTS contract to an OH plugin/native speech service; confirm device/voice/API eligibility and every speak/stop/cancel call site. Settings navigation alone is not complete TTS coverage.

findings.verdict: Renderer simplification is visible; its exact technical necessity is unexplained.
findings.observed: MarkdownBody omits custom builders while keeping highlight imports and helpers. README lists code highlighting as not implemented.
findings.next_step: Reconnect a compatible builder and test languages, selection and long blocks. Classify the code-level omission separately from the author’s broad dependency explanation.

findings.verdict: Missing application factory branch, with a separate native service entitlement gate.
findings.observed: NotificationFactory supports Android/iOS only and throws for other targets; reminder settings are hidden despite an OH notification dependency.
findings.next_step: Implement an OH scheduling adapter and request required entitlement/permissions, or use an appropriate calendar alternative. Ordinary notifications do not prove scheduled-reminder support.

findings.verdict: Historical platform guard was removed; current source selects another OCR backend.
findings.observed: The April diff adds a Harmony exception, the May diff removes it, and the pinned current OcrService loads scu_ocr_lite model bytes and calls recognizeAsync.
findings.next_step: Validate the pinned model/backend on the target. Restored source does not prove accuracy, speed or successful PC execution.

findings.verdict: Historical Flutter SDK mismatch, followed by source restoration.
findings.observed: The restoration diff replaces the commented fl_chart import and LineChart with active code and explicitly names the older OH Flutter baseline in removed comments.
findings.next_step: Exercise the chart on the current pinned SDK; do not carry the old disablement forward as an OS limitation.

findings.verdict: App-local fallback; its blanket OS-unsupported comment is contradicted by native documentation.
findings.observed: AppClipboard stores text in a static string and is used by custom copy/paste handling. It cannot exchange text with other applications.
findings.next_step: Use the framework clipboard bridge or native pasteboard with permitted user-triggered access; test cross-app read/write and denial.

findings.feature: Accounts, network services and community features
findings.verdict: Explicit offline Lite product scope.
findings.observed: README defines a standalone offline edition and lists removed account/community/network features.
findings.next_step: Treat restoration as a product/security/service-scope decision. The removals do not establish a HarmonyOS networking ban.

findings.feature: BLE paired/scanning-state queries and unpair semantics
findings.verdict: Adapter shortcuts; native semantics were not established by these return values.
findings.observed: isScanning/isPaired return false, pair returns true as a no-pair-required convention, and unpair ignores the operation. Actual scan/connect calls elsewhere use native channels.
findings.next_step: Separate not-needed, unsupported and unknown states. Audit native pairing APIs for the actual BLE workflow instead of reporting stub success as completed pairing.

findings.verdict: Local Flutter plugin stub and UI disablement.
findings.observed: OHOS_BUILD says flutter_reactive_ble is replaced with a local stub and disables scale scanning; it also states the port had not been compiled/device-validated by its author.
findings.next_step: Replace or implement the BLE plugin and device protocol, then validate on the intended scale and PC hardware. Official BLE APIs do not prove this scale protocol works.

findings.verdict: Application platform capability flags.
findings.observed: OhosNeonPlatform hard-codes all three capabilities false. No native rejection or per-feature root cause is supplied by that class.
findings.next_step: Audit each selected plugin and native service separately; distinguish Push Kit onboarding from local notifications and desktop window management from in-app navigation.

findings.verdict: App-owned single-file guard; no OS-wide batch-I/O limit established.
findings.observed: _downloadForOhos immediately returns when filesToDownload.length > 1. A single-file OH export path exists below it.
findings.next_step: Design a sequential authorized export queue or folder-grant flow with cancellation/partial completion. A one-file picker operation is not proof that a batch workflow is impossible.

findings.verdict: Android-specific integration semantics; generic adaptive colors remain a different feature.
findings.observed: README removes dynamic_color and uses a fixed theme because its Material You integration is absent.
findings.next_step: Decide whether exact Android system-palette parity is required or an image-derived/application palette is acceptable. Do not equate those two contracts.

findings.verdict: Explicit no-op plugin replacement.
findings.observed: The OH universal_gamepad replacement returns empty input/connection streams and an empty gamepad list.
findings.next_step: Investigate target-device input APIs and the plugin bridge. This review establishes a stub, not native gamepad availability or a guaranteed remedy.
